list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum pops on its own. It is the last trophy by design, so follow the roadmap stages in order and treat this as the finish line, not a task of its own.
trophies.missable_note: Unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned; nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, until its end. It is the first story mission, so this trophy comes naturally at the start of the game.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission; unmissable as part of the opening.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances, so keep playing the main missions in order.
trophies.missable_note: Chapter completion; unmissable by playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks as the story moves on — no side content is needed for it.
trophies.missable_note: Chapter completion; unmissable by playing the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep following the main story path and this unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.missable_note: Chapter completion; unmissable by playing the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it marks that the end of the story is near.
trophies.missable_note: Chapter completion; unmissable by playing the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It is the gold story trophy, so finish the campaign and it unlocks at the credits.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission; unmissable by finishing the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. It is a named mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing that mission to its end.
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission; whether missions can be replayed is unconfirmed before release, so do it when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually multi-part, so follow each objective through to the getaway and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission; mission replay is unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it when the story offers it and finish it to unlock the trophy.
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission; mission replay is unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is one of the named mission trophies, so it unlocks by finishing that mission in the story.
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission; mission replay is unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name points to the Vice City airport, so expect an airport-set mission and finish it to unlock the trophy.
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission; mission replay is unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the operation to its end and the trophy unlocks with the mission complete screen.
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission; mission replay is unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger strands, activities and collectibles the completion checklist counts. Check the in-game stats page to see what is left, clear it piece by piece, and this gold unlocks with the platinum right behind it.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative completion; nothing is missable as long as every checklist item is done before or after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and similar driving feats — anywhere in free roam. The counter is cumulative, so weave stunt moves into normal driving and use ramps and jumps to rack them up faster.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative counter; grindable in free roam at any time.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity at least once. The official list names nine kinds of activity across its other descriptions — racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt driving — so sample one of each; if one does not count toward the trophy, try the next, and it pops once every type the game counts has been tried.
trophies.missable_note: Trying each activity once; all activities stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Exophase · PSNProfiles — official trophy list (activity types inferred from the official list)

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge can be retried, so learn the target patterns, practise your aim, and clear them one weapon class at a time.
trophies.missable_note: Repeatable challenges; retry any challenge until gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates, cut corners where the drone allows it, and retry any location you lose until you have won everywhere.
trophies.missable_note: Repeatable races; every location stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one. Pick a fast, well-handling car for each race type and work through the race list.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative wins across different races; repeatable.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges are scored on the catch, so use the best rod and bait you have, watch the line tension, and challenge Cal again if he out-fishes you.
trophies.missable_note: Fishing challenge; repeatable until won.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade machine. Pick the game you find easiest, learn its pattern in a practice run, then play a full game through to its end.
trophies.missable_note: Any arcade game; repeatable.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger and contact strands unlock as the story progresses, so keep checking back with Andy between story missions until his last one appears.
trophies.missable_note: Contact strand finale; whether strands stay open after the story is unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Work through his jobs as they appear and the trophy unlocks when his last mission is complete.
trophies.missable_note: Contact strand finale; post-story availability unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Keep taking Billy's jobs when they show up and complete his last one to unlock this.
trophies.missable_note: Contact strand finale; post-story availability unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map; take each one's jobs through to the strand's end, and do eight of them for this silver.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strands stay open in free roam; eight completions needed.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take Randy's jobs as they appear and complete his last mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.missable_note: Contact strand finale; post-story availability unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Work through Tyrone's jobs in order and the trophy unlocks at the end of his last mission.
trophies.missable_note: Contact strand finale; post-story availability unconfirmed before release.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are scattered through the state, so visit each one and meditate there; the count is the one PlayStation tracks (18), and no spot-by-spot map is confirmed before release, so work through the map systematically until the last spot is done.
trophies.missable_note: Collectible-style locations; all spots stay visitable in free roam.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow Bret's strand until he names the animal and its hunting ground, then track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring the hunt back to him.
trophies.missable_note: Hunting strand; the animal hunt stays available once Bret offers it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, so pick up every card you spot, trade duplicates if the game allows it, and finish three sets to unlock this silver.
trophies.missable_note: Collectible cards; all locations stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase · PSNProfiles — official trophy list (count: 3 sets)

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each new spot counts once, so work through the map systematically — a new location each time — until you reach 100.
trophies.missable_note: Location-based counter; all 100 spots stay visitable in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges cover driving, shooting, exploration and more, so take on whichever ones suit your play and the counter climbs toward 50.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative challenges; grindable in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, use alleys and tunnels to shake the search, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.
trophies.missable_note: Repeatable in free roam whenever your partner is with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without letting your wanted level drop between them. Plan a route past three close shops, keep the robberies quick, and keep the heat on until the third till is empty.
trophies.missable_note: Repeatable in free roam; partner required, so do it while your partner is available.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive, ride or steal anything new you see — each new vehicle type counts once — and work through traffic, parking lots and dealerships to find them all.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative discovery; vehicles keep appearing in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Trigger it in a busy firefight with enemies grouped together, aim for quick successive takedowns, and all five must fall before the focus ends.
trophies.missable_note: Combat feat; retry in any firefight with enough enemies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — take a plane or vehicle out through the airport without following the normal departure. This is the one trophy tied to a single airport moment, so do it the first time the chance appears.
trophies.missable_note: Possible missable: tied to a one-time departure at VCIA, so grab it when the opportunity appears.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Rhino tanks deploy when the heat is highest, so build a high wanted level and tangle with one: steal a Rhino and drive it, or survive an encounter with one. The description is a joke — “Kinda hot in these Rhinos” — so the trophy is about the tank itself, not a mission; retry in any high-wanted-level chase.
trophies.missable_note: Rhino encounter; tanks appear in high-wanted-level chases.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get out with the goods before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.missable_note: Stealth robbery; retry the store if you are spotted.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each vault job, grab the cash, then lose the wanted level before the next — five clean getaways earn this silver.
trophies.missable_note: Repeatable vault robberies; five escapes needed.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash, then shake the wanted level to complete the getaway.
trophies.missable_note: Repeatable; armored trucks patrol the roads in free roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named district and region until the map is filled in — the in-game stats show which areas are still unvisited.
trophies.missable_note: Exploration; every area stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Exophase · PSNProfiles — official trophy list (count: 52 areas)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation on the map, hit it, and work through all nine gangs to unlock this.
trophies.missable_note: One operation per gang; all gangs stay active in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase · PSNProfiles — official trophy list (count: 9 gangs)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beach bar, order a drink, and enjoy the view — the trophy pops when the scene plays out.
trophies.missable_note: A beach moment; repeatable any time you visit Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass. Pick a showroom, build speed inside or outside, and crash out through the front.
trophies.missable_note: A stunt moment; repeatable at any vehicle showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game. The trophy is about the follow-through on your throw, so play the game through rather than quitting after one frame — the alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.missable_note: Bowling; the alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal: play activities together with your partner until a shared moment draws a crowd. The official description names no specific activity, so no single one is claimed here — work through the partner activities and this unlocks when the moment lands.
trophies.missable_note: Partner moment; no missable trigger stated in the official description.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — the tracker counts up to 500 choices. Pick dialogue and decision options whenever they appear and the counter climbs; it is cumulative across the whole playthrough.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative choices; the counter builds up across the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase · PSNProfiles — official trophy list (PSN tracks a count to 500)

trophies.guide: “Second time's the charm”: succeed on a second attempt at something you first failed. Pick a short retryable challenge, minigame or mission objective, fail it once, then clear it on the next try — the trophy is about the retry itself, so any second-attempt success counts.
trophies.missable_note: A second-attempt success; retryable by design.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — the description reads like a surprise encounter, an easter-egg-style event out in the world. No location is confirmed before release, so no single spot is claimed here: keep exploring the odd corners of the map — remote places, strange passers-by, out-of-the-way scenes — and the trophy pops when the event triggers.
trophies.missable_note: A random world event; keep exploring and it triggers.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle at a pedestrian. Line up a slow pass, time the swing, and the trophy pops when they go down.
trophies.missable_note: A drive-by feat; repeatable in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, so keep laundering the take through contacts until the total reaches $250,000.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative money total; laundering stays available through contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food and anything else counts toward the total. Buy what you need as you play and the counter reaches $100,000 naturally.
trophies.missable_note: Cumulative spending; any shop purchase counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Each one costs money, so save up from missions and robberies, buy them one by one, and the trophy pops with the last deed.
trophies.missable_note: Property purchases; all 8 garages stay buyable in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you own or pick up, open the app, and register each one — ten registrations earns the trophy.
trophies.missable_note: App registrations; repeatable with any vehicles you find.
trophies.name: On the Spot
